garrick_legends.title: Garrick's Alleged Stenchmaster Legends
garrick_legends.byline: <k>Told by</> the Grand Stenchmaster. <k>Doubted by</> everyone.

entries.title: VERIFIED STENCHMASTER HISTORY
entries.claim: Everything below this line is a legend told by the Grand Stenchmaster. None of it has been verified by anyone. This line is the only verified history.
entries.note: Still empty. Still the only true entry.

entries.title: Brogath the Bashful
entries.claim: An ancient Grand Stenchmaster, terribly shy about his releases. Owned a huge treasure. Got tired after three minutes of digging. One mighty blast: the treasure went up into a shark storm, the sharks got rich, and the biggest shark wore his crown. The lesson: ALWAYS HIRE A GRAND SHARKMASTER.
entries.source: Garrick's bedtime story (out of his book, in the galley, by lamplight)
entries.note: He invented him five minutes ago. (Jim: he invented the entire thing after dinner, on the back of a bean label.) It happened to US. THIS AFTERNOON. (Pete.)

variants.evidence: None. Cited on the television, by a shark, as legal precedent ('See: Brogath'). Being on television is not evidence.
variants.note: He invented him after dinner. Now a shark's lawyer is quoting him. Still not verified. Still not real, as far as anybody can prove.

entries.title: The Grand Expedition for the Lost Fart
entries.caption: The Grand Expedition for the Lost Fart: Complete Grand Stenchmaster Legends. Volume One of Probably Many.
entries.claim: 'The Grand Expedition for the Lost Fart: Complete Grand Stenchmaster Legends - Volume One of Probably Many.' The collected wisdom of the Grand Stenchmasters of old.
entries.evidence: Old ledger paper, salvaged notebooks and blank pages, in crayon. Stained. Badly bound. It smells like him. Volume One of a series of one.
entries.note: I read it at night, at the long table, when he was asleep. I'm not proud. It's not a reliable source. It's the only source.

entries.title: Rumpold Windbreaker the Resolute
entries.caption: The Rumpold chapter. In crayon.
entries.claim: A Grand Stenchmaster who faced a tornado rear-first, waited for the eye, the very centre, and met wind with opposing wind; the rotation was disrupted and the funnel collapsed. Afterwards (he says) the rain, the rivers, the bay and the local sea reeked 'fifty times worse than a fresh release. Fifty-plus. Approximately fifty-three.'
entries.source: Garrick's second bedtime story (the same book)
entries.note: It's a story. It's also the only plan anybody's got.

variants.note: It's a story. We tried it anyway. He faced the wrong way. (Rumpold, allegedly, did not.)

entries.title: The Fifty-Three Times Claim
entries.claim: A Rumpold-sized counter-blast leaves the local sea reeking fifty to fifty-three times worse than a fresh release.
entries.evidence: None. Nobody has measured it. Nobody knows how you would.
entries.note: I wrote it in the plan as a POSSIBLE CONSEQUENCE, with (HE SAYS.) after it. Then I wrote STILL CONSIDERING IT.

entries.title: The Five Hundred Times Guess
entries.claim: Into open water instead of into the storm: 'MAYBE five hundred times.'
entries.source: Garrick, at the bow, losing his nerve
entries.evidence: None. He said himself: 'That's a guess. I'm not a scientist.'
entries.note: He was trying to talk me out of it. Then he did it anyway, into the ocean. Nobody's measuring the sea. Nobody's going to.

entries.title: The Ancient Stenchmaster Transfer Doctrine
entries.claim: 'Fart It, Lose It.' Treasure a Grand Stenchmaster blasts into the sky belongs to whoever catches it. Chapter Forty-Seven. See: Brogath.
entries.source: The Bling Bling King, on the Frog Tax Man, citing Garrick's book as ancient legal authority
entries.evidence: None. The book has nowhere near forty-seven chapters.
entries.note: Garrick: 'That's MADE UP!' Everyone turned round and looked at him, slowly. He revised it: 'an incorrect interpretation of sacred lore.'

bbk_trash.title: The Bling Bling King's Participation Trash
bbk_trash.byline: <k>Thrown by</> the Bling Bling King. <k>Kept</> as evidence.

entries.title: Official Participation Treasure
entries.caption: TREASURE IS ABOUT THE JOURNEY!
entries.printed: TREASURE IS ABOUT THE JOURNEY! / OFFICIAL PARTICIPATION TREASURE. CONGRATULATIONS - YOU FOUND IT! VALUE: GREAT MEMORIES. NO CASH VALUE.
entries.arrived: Spat onto the deck by the Bling Bling King, the day it came back
entries.verdict: Plastic. The gold comes off on your thumb. I threw it at the Grand Stenchmaster. He gave it back: 'We DID participate.'

entries.title: The Sharks' Leftovers
entries.arrived: Out of the sky, like hail, after the sharks' catered dinner
entries.value: Lobster shells, crab shells, a foil tray of oyster shells, a takeout box, a caviar tin licked clean, napkins, a little fork. Paid for with my treasure.
entries.verdict: Swept over the side. All three heaps. We are NOT eating the sharks' leftovers.

entries.title: Bedtime Tokens
entries.caption: SWEET DREAMS! WE KEPT THE GOOD PILLOWS!
entries.printed: SWEET DREAMS! WE KEPT THE GOOD PILLOWS! / REST EASY! YOUR GOLD IS COMFORTABLE! / ENJOY THE FLOOR! SHARK SUITES ARE SOLD OUT!
entries.arrived: Down the galley hatch, at night, one at a time
entries.verdict: The sharks have pillows. We have one.

entries.title: 'Captain Under Fart Suit'
entries.caption: CAPTAIN UNDER FART SUIT
entries.printed: CAPTAIN / UNDER FART SUIT (a picture: a hammock, and something under it)
entries.arrived: Down the hatch, the same night
entries.verdict: Squawks read it out loud. I broke it in half.

entries.title: The Grand Award Ribbon
entries.caption: GRAND PRIZE.
entries.printed: GRAND PRIZE FOR FINDING TREASURE FOR SOMEBODY ELSE. EXCELLENCE IN ACCIDENTAL SHARK ENRICHMENT. SPECIAL MENTION: MANAGING ONE (1) GRAND STENCHMASTER (SORT OF).
entries.arrived: Down the hatch. Stuck to me.
entries.verdict: It's still on my coat. The glitter is never coming off.

entries.title: The Leadership Trophy
entries.caption: FOR HIRING A FART MAN.
entries.printed: FOR HIRING A FART MAN. DUTIES: EAT, SLEEP, TV, FARTS.
entries.arrived: Down the hatch with a clang
entries.verdict: He wants it known he is a GRAND STENCHMASTER. The crew went through his duties one by one. They're not wrong. Squawks: 'Fart man.'

entries.title: Free Advice
entries.caption: GOOD LUCK WITH YOUR FART PLAN!
entries.printed: GOOD LUCK WITH YOUR FART PLAN! / FREE ADVICE: FEWER GRAND TITLES, MORE JOB DESCRIPTIONS.
entries.arrived: On deck, while we were planning. They knew. HOW did they know?
entries.verdict: The second one is, regrettably, good advice.

entries.title: Approach Tokens
entries.caption: WE LOVE BAD DECISIONS.
entries.printed: WE LOVE BAD DECISIONS. / BRAVERY OR TERRIBLE JUDGMENT?
entries.arrived: All over the deck, on the way in

entries.title: The Certificate of Grand Cowardice
entries.caption: (TOO GRAND)
entries.printed: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER GRAND CERTIFICATE OF GRAND COWARDICE, GRAND HONOURABLE MENTION, GRAND COMMITTEE FOR GRANDLY NOT DOING IT (TOO GRAND).
entries.arrived: Out of the sky, onto him, at the bow, with a sash that fluttered
entries.verdict: It worked. It got him back to the stern. Then he ran again.

entries.title: The Last One (So Far)
entries.caption: GOOD NIGHT, FART MAN! THANKS FOR THE RIDE!
entries.printed: GOOD NIGHT, FART MAN! THANKS FOR THE RIDE!
entries.arrived: Down the hatch, inside the storm, while he napped
entries.verdict: They're right next to us now. They can throw them by hand.

variants.where: Up. In the storm, all round us. On the sharks.
variants.holder: The Great Sharkstorm; the sharks; the Bling Bling King (the Crimson King's Crown, on its head; a second-best jewelled crown, paid on television as TAX)
variants.notes: Found. Dug. Blown into the Great Sharkstorm. Recovered: about two per cent, contaminated. Spent by the sharks: lobster, catering, bedding, an ADVERTISING CAMPAIGN. One of my crowns was handed to a frog in a tax office, on television, by a shark. Recovered since: nothing. Not yet.

variants.holder: The Great Sharkstorm; the sharks (who are SPENDING it); the Bling Bling King
variants.notes: Found. Dug. Blown into the Great Sharkstorm. Recovered: about two per cent, out of the crater, contaminated. The rest is up there, going round, and the sharks are spending it: catered seafood, delivered, paid for in crowns.

variants.where: The Great Sharkstorm. And, somehow, the television.
variants.holder: The Crimson King's Crown; a gold chain thick as a hawser; a diamond pendant reading BLING BLING KING
variants.notes: The crowned megalodon. Lifted out of the lagoon by the storm and brought back in a chain, as the Bling Bling King. It never says a word. It throws things. Then it was on the Frog Tax Man, TALKING: smooth, friendly, quoting his book as law, paying its tax with my crown, and then an advertisement. It can't have been. Nobody can explain it.

variants.where: The Great Sharkstorm (it comes down to gloat)
variants.holder: The Crimson King's Crown; a gold chain thick as a hawser; a diamond pendant reading BLING BLING KING
variants.notes: The crowned megalodon. The storm lifted it out of the lagoon; it came back up under the Revenge in a chain, as THE BLING BLING KING. It never says a word. It throws things: coins, tokens, ribbons, trophies, rubbish. Plastic, mostly. Mockery, entirely.

variants.where: Gone from the lagoon (up into the storm)

variants.holder: The Revenge (us). The Fortune. The Bling Bling King.
variants.notes: He fired the wrong way: into the ocean. The blast pushed the Revenge backwards, stern-first, straight into the Great Sharkstorm, and we're in it now, going round. Not destroyed. Not stopped. Treasure-laden. Sharks in jewellery going past the portholes. The nap can wait, he says.

variants.where: Right in front of the bow

entries.title: The Crater Salvage
entries.caption: Gristle's tally of the saddest salvage.
entries.notes: Twenty-seven gold coins, a few silver ones, four small emeralds, a ruby, half a necklace, a cracked goblet, a bent ceremonial spoon, six pearls and a suspicious brass button. Everything smells like him. 'Direct-blast exposure. Second-layer bouquet.' I've asked him to stop reviewing the coins.

entries.title: The Queen Anne's Revenge
entries.notes: Rigging like knitting. A hull that's been through a sharkstorm. A sick bell. A galley that is now also the bedroom. A barracks full of vented Spicy Stench Sauce. Old quarters: STILL condemned (Rusty Tom checked).

variants.where: Inside the Great Sharkstorm, going round
variants.notes: Propelled stern-first into the Great Sharkstorm by a wrong-way blast. Trapped inside, going round. Holding together, just. Everybody below in the galley. The Mark II working, on a can of Spicy Stench Sauce.

entries.title: The Local Sea
entries.notes: He fired into the ocean. The sea came up brown and green and yellow, in bubbles the size of the longboat. The fish left. Why green? BEANS. How much worse than a fresh release? Garrick guessed: maybe five hundred times. A guess. Nobody's measured it.
